Subject: Operational AI pilot — pausing timeline

Hi Kimberly / Marissa,

Thanks again for the detailed demo last Thursday — the team found the latency/cost breakdown really helpful. I wanted to follow up with an update from our product leadership: we've had a hard pivot this week. The execs are moving a cross-functional launch to the top of the Q3 roadmap and resources are being reallocated to the launch backlog.

Because of that, we're going to pause work on the inference pilot for now. That means we need to release the dedicated demo window and put the project on hold. We still think Redwood is a fit; this is purely a timing/prioritization decision on our side.

Can you please mark the opportunity as paused on your side and hold any upcoming scheduling/engineering prep? We'd like to revisit once our launch window opens up — likely late Q4 but that could move. I'll share an internal update next week with a clearer timeline.

Apologies for the abrupt change — appreciate your flexibility.

Best,
Elena Ruiz
Group Product Manager, Novacorp
